title: What the EU AI Act means for a 30-person B2B SaaS with LLM features
variant: One airy column, the verdict in the headline, plain bullets
prompt: TLDR on what the EU AI Act means for a 30-person B2B SaaS that uses LLM features.
note: One airy column with a headline that states the verdict in two sentences, because the reader is a founder who wants to know in ten seconds whether to worry, and the answer is mostly no.
